briefing.text: Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia CEO after a board vote, and shares jumped about 31%.
The FCC approved SpaceX's plan for up to a million AI computing satellites.
GTA VI sold an estimated 44.9 million copies in its first four days.
A US jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 counts in a trade secrets case.
Focker-In-Law opened for Thanksgiving with Stiller and De Niro back.

stories.title: Nvidia's board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, and the shares jump about 30%
stories.summary: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on November 23 to bring back Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, days after his resignation.
stories.why: Nvidia is the most important supplier of AI chips, so who runs it moves markets and politics.
stories.happened: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to bring Huang back, and shares rose about 31%, reports say. CNBC reported he told staff Nvidia does not need a traditional succession plan.
stories.next: Watch for the December 3 Senate hearing and the board's ongoing independent investigation.

drivers.label: U-turn
drivers.text: The board had ruled out his return only days earlier.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Reports put the one-day share gain near 30%, its biggest since 2003.

drivers.label: Politics
drivers.text: Lawmakers from both parties have criticised the decision.

stories.background: Jensen Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and ran it for over three decades as it became the leading maker of AI chips.

meme.top: Nvidia searched far and wide for a CEO
meme.bottom: and found him in the old office
meme.take: Nvidia ran a thorough CEO search and found the candidate had excellent references.

stories.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan for up to one million AI data centre satellites
stories.summary: The FCC approved SpaceX's proposed Starmind network of up to one million satellites for computing in low Earth orbit.
stories.why: Putting AI computing in orbit is one of the boldest answers yet to the shortage of power and space on the ground.
stories.happened: Gizmodo reports the approval covers a potential network, not satellites already in orbit. Scientists quoted by AP question whether the economics and cooling can work.
stories.next: Watch for SpaceX's launch timeline and any customers named for Starmind.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: One million satellites would dwarf every constellation flying today.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: AI firms are racing to find power and space for new data centres.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Scientists have raised doubts about cost and cooling in orbit.

stories.background: SpaceX is Elon Musk's rocket company and runs the Starlink satellite internet network.

meme.top: The FCC approved a million satellites
meme.bottom: the sky has run out of parking
meme.take: A million AI satellites got approved, and astronomers have quietly updated their résumés.

stories.title: GTA VI sold an estimated 44.9 million copies in its first four days
stories.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA VI sold 44.9 million units and grossed over $4 billion by the end of its launch weekend.
stories.why: GTA VI is the most anticipated game in years, and its sales are a benchmark for the whole industry.
stories.happened: The figures are a third-party estimate reported by The Fly; Take-Two has not confirmed them. The game launched on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S at $79.99, with no PC date yet.
stories.next: Watch for Take-Two's own sales figures and any PC release date.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Tens of millions of copies in days is close to unheard of.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The game sells at $79.99, above the usual price.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' best-selling series; GTA V came out in 2013. Rockstar is owned by Take-Two.

meme.top: GTA VI sold 44.9 million copies
meme.bottom: the traffic in Vice City is now real
meme.take: GTA VI sold an estimated 44.9 million copies, and every one of them is stuck in traffic.

stories.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 designed proteins that bound to five targets in the lab
stories.summary: OpenAI reports that GPT-6 models designed protein sequences using reasoning and code, and lab tests found binding to five targets.
stories.why: Drug discovery is one of the most valuable things AI could speed up, so lab-tested results draw attention.
stories.happened: OpenAI says the models worked out sequences through step-by-step reasoning and code rather than a specialised biology model. Lab experiments found evidence of binding to five targets.
stories.next: Watch for independent scientists testing or reproducing the designs.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: A general model, not a biology tool, produced the designs.

drivers.label: Science
drivers.text: Results were checked in wet-lab experiments, OpenAI says.

stories.background: OpenAI makes ChatGPT and the GPT series of AI models.

meme.top: A chatbot designed a protein
meme.bottom: and it still cannot fold laundry
meme.take: GPT-6 can now design proteins, which puts it ahead of most people's New Year plans.

stories.title: Focker-In-Law opens for Thanksgiving with Stiller and De Niro back
stories.summary: The fourth Meet the Parents film opened in cinemas on November 25, with Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro returning.
stories.why: It revives a big comedy franchise for the busiest family moviegoing week of the year.
stories.happened: Owen Wilson and Teri Polo also return, and Ariana Grande and Skyler Gisondo join the cast. It opened the same day as Disney's Hexed, setting up a holiday weekend contest.
stories.next: Watch for the five-day Thanksgiving box office numbers.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The series began with Meet the Parents in 2000.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Ariana Grande joins the franchise.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opened on the busy Thanksgiving week.

stories.background: Meet the Parents is a comedy series about a nurse and his fearsome ex-CIA father-in-law.

meme.top: A film about meeting the in-laws
meme.bottom: opens the day before you meet yours
meme.take: Focker-In-Law opens on Thanksgiving week, a lighter version of what awaits families.

stories.title: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120 million in the US and $225 million worldwide
stories.summary: The Hunger Games prequel opened to an estimated $120 million in North America and $225 million worldwide, AP reports.
stories.why: A strong debut would show book-based franchises can still fill cinemas in a crowded holiday season.
stories.happened: It took $56 million on Friday, including $21 million in previews, and made up about 72% of all weekend ticket sales. Audiences gave it an A- CinemaScore, up from B+ for the last prequel.
stories.next: Watch for how it holds over the Thanksgiving five-day weekend against Hexed and Focker In-Law.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: It beat Lionsgate's own $85 million weekend forecast.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It was about 2.7 times the opening of The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opened the week before Thanksgiving, a strong window for long runs.

stories.background: The Hunger Games films are based on Suzanne Collins' novels. This is the second prequel, following a young Haymitch Abernathy.

meme.top: A film about a deadly televised contest
meme.bottom: is winning its own contest
meme.take: The Hunger Games returns to cinemas, which are once again fighting to survive the weekend.

stories.title: US jury convicts Huawei on 10 of 12 counts in trade secrets case
stories.summary: A federal jury in Brooklyn found Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts in a long-running trade secrets and fraud case.
stories.why: Huawei sits at the centre of US-China tech tensions, so a verdict carries weight beyond the courtroom.
stories.happened: CNBC reported the verdict on November 25. The case centred on accusations of trade secret theft and fraud brought by US prosecutors.
stories.next: Watch for sentencing and any appeal from Huawei.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is a major moment in the US-China tech contest.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Huawei is one of the world's largest telecoms makers.

stories.background: Huawei is a Chinese maker of telecoms equipment and phones, under US restrictions since 2019.

meme.top: A jury reviewed Huawei's case
meme.bottom: and gave it ten out of twelve
meme.take: Huawei scored ten out of twelve with a US jury, the one test it wanted to fail.

stories.title: OpenAI preprint claims the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4
stories.summary: OpenAI posted a maths preprint claiming the exponent of matrix multiplication is 9/4, a result not yet independently checked.
stories.why: Faster matrix multiplication is a famous open problem, and AI labs now compete to claim maths results.
stories.happened: The paper appeared in OpenAI's public maths repository on November 24. Roundups stress it has not been independently validated. It follows other AI-assisted maths claims this month.
stories.next: Watch for mathematicians reviewing the proof and whether it holds up.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: AI labs are trading big maths claims this month.

drivers.label: Big claim
drivers.text: The exponent has been an open question for decades.

stories.background: Matrix multiplication underpins much of computing, including the training of AI models.

meme.top: OpenAI says the answer is 9/4
meme.bottom: reviewers say show your working
meme.take: An AI lab says it settled an old maths problem, pending the small matter of checking.

stories.title: Academy rules fully AI-made film ineligible for Best Animated Feature
stories.summary: The Academy ruled that Gods Don't Give Gifts, a feature made entirely with generative AI, cannot compete for Best Animated Feature.
stories.why: It is a clear early line on where Hollywood's top awards stand on AI-made films.
stories.happened: IndieWire reports the film comes from the YouTuber known as Gossip Goblin. The filmmakers plan to appeal and to give it a cinema run from December 4.
stories.next: Watch for the appeal and the film's December 4 release.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: AI in filmmaking is one of Hollywood's most divisive issues.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It tests the rules with a fully AI-generated feature.

stories.background: The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences runs the Oscars.

meme.top: An AI made a whole animated film
meme.bottom: the Academy said it can watch
meme.take: The Academy told a fully AI-made film it cannot enter, which the film took as a review.

stories.title: GTA VI gets its first big third-party discount in Loaded's Black Friday sale
stories.summary: Loaded's Black Friday sale cuts GTA VI on Xbox to $67.49 and discounts five of the six Game of the Year nominees.
stories.why: GTA VI is barely a week old, so any discount on it stands out.
stories.happened: GAMINGbible reports the sale runs until December 1 with over 800 deals. GTA VI on Xbox starts from $67.49, down from $79.99, and 007 First Light is up to 57% off.
stories.next: Watch for whether other retailers cut GTA VI prices over Black Friday.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The sale lands one week after GTA VI's launch.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Discounts reach 57% on some nominees.

stories.background: Loaded, formerly CDKeys, is a digital game key seller; GTA VI leads The Game Awards nominations.

meme.top: GTA VI is already on sale
meme.bottom: the game lasted longer than most diets
meme.take: GTA VI went on sale within a week, which is the most realistic crime in the game.

stats.label: GTA VI on Xbox in sale

stories.title: CIA and US intelligence office reportedly hit by breach of unclassified data
stories.summary: Some unclassified information at the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence was breached, The New York Times reports.
stories.why: A breach at the top US spy agencies, even of unclassified systems, raises questions about government security.
stories.happened: Reuters relayed the New York Times report that the CIA and ODNI had some unclassified information breached. AP, citing a source, said an unclassified CIA system was hit in a cyberattack. Details remain limited.
stories.next: Watch for an official statement on what was taken and who was behind it.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The CIA is among the most security-conscious organisations in the world.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Even unclassified government data can be useful to attackers.

stories.background: The Office of the Director of National Intelligence oversees the US intelligence agencies, including the CIA.

meme.top: The spy agency lost some files
meme.bottom: the unclassified kind, they stress
meme.take: Some unclassified CIA data is now, presumably, even less classified.

stories.title: Amazon says an open-source AI agent exploited an unknown flaw mostly on its own
stories.summary: Amazon reportedly detected an open-source AI agent exploiting a previously unknown vulnerability with limited human help.
stories.why: Autonomous AI hacking has long been a feared scenario, and this is reported as a real case.
stories.happened: Gizmodo reports that Amazon described the agent as mostly autonomous in exploiting the zero-day. The agent was open source rather than from a major lab, according to the report.
stories.next: Watch for details of the flaw, the patch and how defenders respond.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: It is a reported real-world case of AI finding and using a new flaw.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Amazon runs one of the world's largest cloud platforms.

stories.background: A zero-day is a software flaw that attackers exploit before the maker has a fix.

meme.top: An AI agent found a zero-day
meme.bottom: and did not even ask for a raise
meme.take: An AI agent hacked a system mostly by itself, finally a job automation nobody wanted.

stories.title: Netflix streams Packers at Rams on Thanksgiving Eve with U2 at halftime
stories.summary: Netflix listed the Packers at Rams game for November 25, with a U2 halftime performance.
stories.why: Live sport is the biggest test of whether streamers can replace traditional TV.
stories.happened: TVLine's November 25 listings put the NFL game on Netflix with U2 playing the halftime show. It adds to Netflix's growing run of live events.
stories.next: Watch for Netflix's viewing figures for the game.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: U2 headlined the halftime show.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Streamers are spending heavily on live sport.

stories.background: Netflix has added live NFL games to its service in recent years.

meme.top: Netflix now has football and U2
meme.bottom: the album may already be on your phone
meme.take: Netflix booked U2 for halftime, and nobody had to download anything this time.

stories.title: FBI's national crime database reportedly breached
stories.summary: A breach of the FBI's National Crime Information Center database has been reported, with its scope still unconfirmed.
stories.why: The database is used by police across the US, so any compromise is serious.
stories.happened: A weekly incident roundup lists the breach as reported, with the scope not yet confirmed and an investigation ongoing. It comes days after reports of breaches at US intelligence agencies.
stories.next: Watch for the FBI to confirm what was accessed.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Police across the US rely on the database.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows reported breaches at US spy agencies.

stories.background: The FBI is the main federal law enforcement agency in the United States.

meme.top: A breach at the FBI's crime database
meme.bottom: was reported, and is being investigated
meme.take: The FBI is investigating a reported breach of its own crime database.

stories.title: SpaceX and Tesla reportedly name directors to negotiate a $3.5 trillion merger
stories.summary: SpaceX and Tesla have each named directors to negotiate a possible merger valued at $3.5 trillion, the Financial Times reports.
stories.why: Combining two of Elon Musk's biggest companies would create one of the most valuable firms ever.
stories.happened: The FT reports five directors were named to negotiate a potential deal, with a target of closing by the end of the year. Neither company has announced a merger.
stories.next: Watch for any formal announcement or shareholder vote from either company.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: A $3.5 trillion combination would be among the largest deals on record.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Both companies are led by Elon Musk.

stories.background: SpaceX builds rockets and runs Starlink; Tesla makes electric cars and batteries. Both are run by Elon Musk.

meme.top: Two Musk companies may merge
meme.bottom: so the meetings get shorter
meme.take: Two Musk companies may merge, saving everyone the trouble of telling them apart.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude agents moved its API from Python to Rust
stories.summary: Anthropic reports that Claude agents migrated its Messages API to Rust, cutting processor use per request by about 70%.
stories.why: It is a large, real engineering job done mostly by AI, with measured results.
stories.happened: Agents compared the old and new versions against live requests, and engineers reviewed the fixes. Anthropic reports about 70% less processor use per request and a 20% shorter median time to first token.
stories.next: Watch for other companies trying AI-led rewrites of production systems.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The Messages API is the core service behind Claude.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI coding agents are moving from small fixes to whole systems.

stories.background: Anthropic is the AI company that makes the Claude models.

meme.top: Claude rewrote its own API in Rust
meme.bottom: and now it will not stop mentioning it
meme.take: Claude rewrote its own plumbing in Rust, the most developer thing an AI has done yet.

stories.title: Disney's animated Hexed leads the Thanksgiving week cinema openings
stories.summary: Disney's Hexed opens wide on November 25, alongside Hershey, Bitter Christmas and A24's Club Kid, with Focker In-Law following on November 27.
stories.why: Thanksgiving is one of the biggest moviegoing weeks of the year, and family films usually lead it.
stories.happened: Occupy Cinema, citing Box Office Mojo's calendar, lists Hexed from Disney, Hershey from Angel Studios and Bitter Christmas from Sony Pictures Classics for Wednesday. AP lists Universal's Focker In-Law for Friday.
stories.next: Watch for the five-day holiday totals and how Hexed fares against the Hunger Games prequel.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Thanksgiving week is a traditional window for family films.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: New openers face the Hunger Games prequel in its second week.

stories.background: Disney animation has often released films over Thanksgiving, including Frozen in 2013.

meme.top: Disney opens a film called Hexed
meme.bottom: on a week of family gatherings
meme.take: Hexed arrives on Thanksgiving, a holiday with plenty of family curses already.

stories.title: ChatGPT merges Chat and Work limits, so heavy users may hit caps sooner
stories.summary: OpenAI says ChatGPT's Chat and Work modes will share one usage allowance, so people who use both heavily may hit limits sooner.
stories.why: Usage limits decide how much paying subscribers actually get for their money.
stories.happened: TechCrunch reports the two modes now draw from a single allowance. The Instant model stays available after the allowance runs out, and a wider rollout is planned for December.
stories.next: Watch for the December rollout and how paid plans' limits change.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It changes what paid subscribers get.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Heavy users are the most vocal ChatGPT audience.

stories.background: ChatGPT is OpenAI's chatbot and one of the most used AI apps in the world.

meme.top: ChatGPT merged work and play
meme.bottom: like most of us did years ago
meme.take: ChatGPT now counts work and chat as one allowance, which is how weekends feel.

stories.title: New York bans AI chatbot toys for five years
stories.summary: Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law banning the manufacture and sale of AI chatbot-powered toys in New York for five years.
stories.why: It is one of the first laws to take AI chatbots out of a whole product category for children.
stories.happened: NBC News reports the ban covers making and selling toys powered by AI chatbots and lasts five years. It arrives just before the holiday shopping season.
stories.next: Watch for toy makers' responses and whether other states follow.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Few places have banned a whole category of AI products.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands at the start of holiday toy shopping.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Child safety is a growing focus of AI rules.

stories.background: New York is one of the biggest US states and often an early mover on tech rules.

meme.top: New York banned toys that chat
meme.bottom: the teddy bear may remain silent
meme.take: New York banned talking AI toys, restoring the classic toy that just stares at you.

stories.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with all eight episodes on November 25
stories.summary: All eight episodes of Blade Runner 2099, starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, stream on Prime Video from today, November 25.
stories.why: It continues one of science fiction's most influential film series on television.
stories.happened: BillFrost.tv says the series, created by Silka Luisa, had been stuck in development since 2024. TVLine also lists all episodes for November 25.
stories.next: Watch for reviews once all the episodes are out.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Blade Runner (1982) is a cult science fiction classic.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Michelle Yeoh leads the cast.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: All episodes drop just before the holiday weekend.

stories.background: Blade Runner is Ridley Scott's 1982 film based on a Philip K. Dick novel. A sequel, Blade Runner 2049, followed in 2017.

meme.top: A show about spotting the machines
meme.bottom: arrives in the year of AI
meme.take: Blade Runner 2099 lands just as the question it asks has become an everyday chore.

stories.title: Ransomware group lists Nvidia as a victim, and Nvidia is investigating
stories.summary: A ransomware group named Nvidia on its leak site, and Nvidia says it is investigating the claim.
stories.why: Nvidia is already in the headlines, and a claimed attack on the AI chip leader draws scrutiny.
stories.happened: An incident roundup reports the listing and Nvidia's confirmation that it is looking into it. No details of any stolen data have been confirmed.
stories.next: Watch for Nvidia's findings and whether any data is confirmed taken.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia is the leading maker of AI chips.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It comes in the same week as its CEO's return.

stories.background: Ransomware groups often post company names on leak sites to pressure them to pay.

meme.top: Nvidia had a quiet week planned
meme.bottom: the week had other plans
meme.take: Nvidia is investigating a ransomware claim, in a week it already had plenty on.

stories.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to let Meta's Muse agent shop on Amazon
stories.summary: Amazon and Meta are said to be negotiating an end to Amazon's September block on Meta's Muse shopping agent.
stories.why: Whether AI agents can shop on Amazon decides who controls online shopping in the agent era.
stories.happened: The Decoder reports ad revenue and search control are part of the talks, citing Amazon's $68.6 billion ad business. It says Muse accounts for 51% of AI agent shopping orders. No deal has been announced.
stories.next: Watch for whether a deal is announced and what Amazon gets in return.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Amazon's ad business is reported at $68.6 billion a year.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Two giants are fighting over who owns the shopper.

stories.background: Muse is Meta's AI assistant, which can also act as a shopping agent.

meme.top: Meta's AI wants to shop at Amazon
meme.bottom: Amazon wants to know who is paying
meme.take: Two of the largest tech firms are negotiating whether a robot can go shopping.

stories.title: CD Projekt signs a Sony marketing deal for The Witcher 4
stories.summary: CD Projekt has signed a marketing deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, and compares its leap over Witcher 3 to GTA V to GTA VI.
stories.why: Marketing deals shape where big games are shown first, and The Witcher 4 is one of the most awaited RPGs.
stories.happened: Gamingroute reports the Sony deal. CD Projekt compares the jump from The Witcher 3 to the jump from GTA V to GTA VI. No release date has been given.
stories.next: Watch for a release window and what the Sony deal includes for PlayStation players.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The Witcher 3 is one of the best-selling RPGs ever.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Marketing deals are a long-running PlayStation and Xbox battleground.

stories.background: CD Projekt Red is the Polish studio behind The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077.

meme.top: CD Projekt compared itself to GTA VI
meme.bottom: during the week of GTA VI
meme.take: CD Projekt compared its next leap to GTA VI, a brave move during GTA VI's week.

stories.title: Anthropic shares fall as investors grow nervous about the AI trade
stories.summary: Anthropic's shares dropped on Tuesday, which Semafor links to wider investor worry about the AI market.
stories.why: Anthropic only recently listed, so its share price is read as a test of AI investor confidence.
stories.happened: Semafor reported the fall on November 24 and tied it to a wobble across AI stocks. Earlier reports said Anthropic listed on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT this month.
stories.next: Watch for how AI stocks trade through the holiday week.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A newly listed AI company is a test of market appetite.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Investors are questioning AI valuations across the sector.

stories.background: Anthropic is the AI company that makes the Claude models.

meme.top: Anthropic went public last week
meme.bottom: and found out what the public thinks
meme.take: Anthropic learned that being a public company mostly means watching a chart.

stories.title: Francis Lawrence says an R-rated Constantine 2 script exists
stories.summary: Director Francis Lawrence reportedly said a script for an R-rated Constantine sequel with Keanu Reeves is written.
stories.why: Fans have wanted a Constantine sequel for about two decades.
stories.happened: In a Hollywood Reporter interview about Sunrise on the Reaping, Lawrence is reported to have discussed the sequel script. He also reportedly said Red Rising has moved from Netflix to Paramount.
stories.next: Watch for whether a studio formally greenlights the sequel.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The first Constantine film came out in 2005.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: A sequel has been requested by fans for years.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Keanu Reeves is attached, per the report.

stories.background: Constantine is a 2005 supernatural film starring Keanu Reeves, based on a DC comic.

meme.top: Constantine 2 has a script
meme.bottom: so it is a rumour with pages
meme.take: A Constantine sequel now has a script, the first step in a long journey called development.

stories.title: Netflix's The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth starts a two-week IMAX run
stories.summary: The Netflix film plays in IMAX cinemas from November 25 for two weeks before it premieres on the service on December 23.
stories.why: Netflix rarely puts its films in big-screen cinemas, so a run like this draws attention.
stories.happened: Occupy Cinema lists the IMAX run starting on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving. AP also describes it as a Netflix IMAX release over the holiday corridor.
stories.next: Watch for its IMAX box office over the holiday weekend.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opens on the busiest moviegoing week of autumn.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Netflix theatrical runs in IMAX are unusual.

stories.background: Cliff Booth was Brad Pitt's stuntman character in the 2019 film Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.

meme.top: A Netflix film is in cinemas
meme.bottom: for exactly as long as it takes
meme.take: Netflix gives Cliff Booth two weeks on the big screen, then the usual couch residency.

stories.title: Switch 2 is reportedly getting three Assassin's Creed ports
stories.summary: Three Assassin's Creed games are reportedly coming to Nintendo Switch 2, though the titles have not been named.
stories.why: Big third-party ports are a key sign of how much support Switch 2 is getting.
stories.happened: GAMINGbible reports the ports as unconfirmed. Ubisoft and Nintendo have not announced them, and the report does not say which games are involved.
stories.next: Watch for an official announcement from Ubisoft or a Nintendo Direct.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Switch 2 is chasing more big third-party games.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Portable versions of large games are popular.

stories.background: Assassin's Creed is Ubisoft's long-running historical action series.

meme.top: Assassin's Creed may come to Switch 2
meme.bottom: the hidden blade now fits in a pocket
meme.take: Three Assassin's Creed ports are reportedly coming, so towers can be climbed on the bus.

stories.title: Breach at La Poste's Maileva exposes data of 22 million people
stories.summary: A breach at Maileva, La Poste's digital mail subsidiary in France, reportedly exposed data of 22 million people.
stories.why: It is one of the largest reported data breaches in Europe this year.
stories.happened: A weekly incident roundup lists the breach at the French postal group's digital unit, with 22 million individuals affected. Details of the data involved were not given.
stories.next: Watch for French regulators' response and advice to affected people.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: 22 million people affected, per reports.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Postal and mail data can be used for scams.

stories.background: La Poste is France's national postal service.

meme.top: A postal service had a data breach
meme.bottom: 22 million records, no stamps
meme.take: A breach at La Poste's digital arm is reported to affect 22 million people.

stories.title: Mario Kart World adds eight remixed courses in a free update
stories.summary: A free update for Mario Kart World on Switch 2 adds eight new remixed courses, GAMINGbible reports.
stories.why: Free content keeps the console's biggest launch game busy heading into the holidays.
stories.happened: The update was reported on November 25. It arrives as Mario Kart World Switch 2 bundles are discounted for Black Friday.
stories.next: Watch for whether Nintendo plans more paid or free course packs.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands just before Black Friday.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: New tracks are the most requested Mario Kart content.

stories.background: Mario Kart World launched with the Switch 2 in 2025 and is its flagship racing game.

meme.top: Eight new tracks in Mario Kart
meme.bottom: eight new places to lose a friendship
meme.take: Mario Kart World added eight courses, each a fresh venue for family arguments this holiday.

stories.title: US blacklists chip firm Megaspeed, and Malaysia orders data centres to cut it off
stories.summary: The US added Singapore's Megaspeed to its trade blacklist amid claims about Nvidia chip exports to China; Malaysia then ordered data centres to cut it off.
stories.why: It shows how US export controls on AI chips now reach data centres across Southeast Asia.
stories.happened: Reuters reported the blacklisting, citing a source. Bloomberg says Malaysia told data centres to cut off Megaspeed and six other blacklisted firms. The BBC says the company denies wrongdoing.
stories.next: Watch for whether other countries in the region follow Malaysia's lead.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is part of the US effort to keep advanced AI chips out of China.

drivers.label: Ripple effect
drivers.text: Malaysia acted within a day of the US move.

stories.background: The US 'entity list' restricts exports to listed firms, and has been used heavily to limit China's access to AI chips.

meme.top: One blacklist in Washington
meme.bottom: seven unplugged racks in Malaysia
meme.take: Washington updated a list, and data centres in Malaysia started pulling cables.

stories.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Sol to paid ChatGPT users
stories.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6.2 Sol to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users, promising better instruction-following.
stories.why: ChatGPT is the most used AI chatbot, so a new default model reaches a huge audience at once.
stories.happened: MacRumors reports the rollout to paid plans, with improvements in following instructions and reading small details. Roundups say it reached paid users worldwide on November 24.
stories.next: Watch for independent tests comparing it with the latest models from Anthropic and Google.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: OpenAI's model updates set the pace for the industry.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It lands amid a busy month of releases from rival labs.

stories.background: OpenAI makes ChatGPT and the GPT family of AI models.

meme.top: OpenAI has a new model that listens
meme.bottom: it was told to ship another model
meme.take: OpenAI's new model is better at following instructions, a rare quality this month.

stories.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie comes to Netflix on November 30
stories.summary: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie joins Netflix's US library on November 30 after its Peacock run, Collider reports.
stories.why: It was the year's first billion-dollar film, so its streaming debut is a big holiday draw.
stories.happened: Collider says the film was the first 2026 release to pass $1 billion at the box office, short of the $1.3 billion of the 2023 original. A further sequel is said not to be expected before 2029.
stories.next: Watch for whether it tops Netflix's film chart in its first week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Mario is Nintendo's most famous character.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It passed $1 billion at the box office.

stories.background: The Super Mario Bros. Movie from Illumination and Nintendo was one of 2023's biggest hits.

meme.top: A billion-dollar film reaches Netflix
meme.bottom: Mario has seen tougher pipes
meme.take: A billion-dollar Mario film lands on Netflix, the couch finally beating the cinema.

stories.title: GTA VI ties Ocarina of Time with a 99 on Metacritic
stories.summary: GTA VI's reviews give it a Metacritic score of 99, level with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Shattered reports.
stories.why: Ocarina of Time has held the top Metacritic spot for decades, so matching it is a rare feat.
stories.happened: Shattered calls it a tie rather than a record broken. GameRant has also covered the gap between critic and user scores on the PlayStation Store and Metacritic.
stories.next: Watch for whether the score holds as more reviews arrive.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Ocarina of Time has long been the benchmark for review scores.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: GTA VI is the biggest release of the year.

stories.background: Metacritic averages critics' reviews into a score out of 100. Ocarina of Time launched on the Nintendo 64 in 1998.

meme.top: GTA VI matched Ocarina of Time
meme.bottom: it only took 28 years and helicopters
meme.take: GTA VI tied Ocarina of Time, and Ocarina did it without a single helicopter.

stories.title: Switch 2 Mario Kart World bundle drops to $499 for Black Friday
stories.summary: Amazon and Walmart are selling the Switch 2 with Mario Kart World for $499, $50 below its $549 price, for a limited time.
stories.why: It is one of the first real price cuts on Nintendo's new console in its first holiday season.
stories.happened: Amazon and Walmart are selling the bundle for $499, which Nintendo Wire calls one of the biggest Switch 2 deals yet. In the UK, Shattered lists the Switch 2 at £399 for Black Friday.
stories.next: Watch for whether stock lasts through Black Friday weekend.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It is $50 off the bundle's usual price.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Black Friday is the biggest console sales week.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Mario Kart is among Nintendo's best-selling series.

stories.background: The Switch 2 is Nintendo's latest console, the follow-up to the 2017 Switch.

meme.top: Fifty dollars off a Switch 2
meme.bottom: the shells are still full price
meme.take: Black Friday takes $50 off Mario Kart, which will be lost to a blue shell by Saturday.

stories.title: Critical Chrome sandbox escape flaw rated 9.6 disclosed
stories.summary: A sandbox escape vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.6 was disclosed for Google Chrome.
stories.why: Chrome is the world's most used browser, so its critical flaws affect huge numbers of people.
stories.happened: An incident roundup lists the flaw as a disclosure rather than an active attack. Sandbox escapes let code break out of the browser's protective layer.
stories.next: Watch for Google's patch and update Chrome when it arrives.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Chrome is used by billions of people.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: A 9.6 rating marks it as critical.

stories.background: Chrome's sandbox keeps web pages walled off from the rest of the computer.

meme.top: Chrome's sandbox had an escape route
meme.bottom: the sand stayed, the walls left
meme.take: Chrome found a hole in its sandbox, so restart your browser before it restarts you.

stories.title: Unilever reportedly cuts about 92% of its Channel 4 ad spend for influencers
stories.summary: Unilever has reportedly cut about 92% of its advertising on Channel 4, moving the money towards social media influencers.
stories.why: It shows how quickly big brands are moving money from TV to creators.
stories.happened: The Guardian reported the cut on November 24. A media roundup says the reduction is more than half of a UK TV budget of nearly £100 million, year on year.
stories.next: Watch for other big advertisers making similar moves.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A UK TV budget near £100 million is affected, per reports.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Ad money keeps moving from TV to creators.

stories.background: Channel 4 is a publicly owned, advertising-funded UK broadcaster; Unilever owns brands like Dove.

meme.top: Unilever moved its money to influencers
meme.bottom: the soap will now be unboxed
meme.take: Unilever swapped Channel 4 for influencers, so its soap now has a ring light.

stories.title: NYC Council says young Kalshi users lost $8.9 million in 10 months
stories.summary: A New York City Council report says Kalshi users aged 18 to 20 lost $8.9 million over 10 months.
stories.why: Prediction market apps are booming, and their appeal to young users worries lawmakers.
stories.happened: The New York Times reported the council's findings on November 24. The figure covers users aged 18 to 20 over a 10-month period.
stories.next: Watch for any city or state action on prediction markets.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: $8.9 million in losses among young users, per the council.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Prediction markets face growing scrutiny.

stories.background: Kalshi is a US prediction market app where people trade on the outcome of events.

meme.top: Young users bet on the future
meme.bottom: the future collected $8.9 million
meme.take: A council report found young Kalshi users lost $8.9 million, the most predictable outcome.

stories.title: Europol operation disrupts 57 illegal streaming services
stories.summary: A Europol-backed operation in Seville disrupted 57 illegal IPTV services and traced €26 million in crypto payments.
stories.why: Piracy costs broadcasters and sports leagues heavily, and crypto payments make it harder to trace.
stories.happened: Investigators from 11 countries took part between November 16 and 20 and identified 321 websites. An anti-piracy group estimates 60 million Europeans use unauthorised IPTV.
stories.next: Watch for arrests or charges linked to the operation.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: 321 websites were identified, per reports.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: €26 million in crypto payments were traced.

stories.background: IPTV piracy sells unlicensed access to TV channels and live sport over the internet.

meme.top: Europol shut down 57 streaming services
meme.bottom: the buffering was finally permanent
meme.take: Europol took down 57 pirate streams, which most viewers will mistake for normal buffering.

stories.title: GTA VI's first big patch, 1.002.002, comes with seven official fixes
stories.summary: Rockstar's update 1.002.002 is live on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and reports now list seven official fixes after it launched with no notes.
stories.why: Millions of new players want to know what a first patch fixes in a game this big.
stories.happened: The update is about 600MB on PS5 and around 1.6GB on Xbox. Pure Xbox reports seven official fixes. Players have also found a Quick Resume bug that unlocks a higher frame rate on Xbox, with drawbacks.
stories.next: Watch for Rockstar's next patch and whether it addresses Xbox performance.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: GTA VI is the biggest launch of the year.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players are tracking every change after release.

stories.background: Rockstar often releases console patches without detailed public notes.

meme.top: Rockstar released a patch with no notes
meme.bottom: the notes arrived later, seven of them
meme.take: GTA VI's first patch shipped first and explained itself later, like its characters.

stories.title: Ant Group releases Ling-3.2-air, an MIT-licensed multimodal model
stories.summary: Ant Group released Ling-3.2-air, a model that handles text, images and video, with open weights under the MIT licence.
stories.why: Chinese labs keep releasing capable open models that anyone can download and build on.
stories.happened: TechNode reports the model's weights are MIT-licensed. Ant says it completed 61% of tasks on its own office-work test, up from 15.7% for Ling-3.0-flash-VL.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmark results.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Open-weight releases from China keep coming.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The company reports a big jump on its own office-task test.

stories.background: Ant Group is the Chinese fintech company behind the Alipay payments app.

meme.top: A payments company built an AI model
meme.bottom: because why not, everyone else did
meme.take: Ant Group released an open AI model, joining the club of companies that are now AI companies.

stories.title: South Korea's KEPCO says breach affected 1.5 million people
stories.summary: Korea Electric Power Corporation disclosed a breach of customer and procurement data affecting 1.5 million people.
stories.why: A breach at a national power company raises concern about critical infrastructure.
stories.happened: An incident roundup reports KEPCO's disclosure. Both customer records and procurement data were involved, according to the report.
stories.next: Watch for South Korean regulators' findings.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: 1.5 million people affected, per the company.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Power utilities are critical infrastructure.

stories.background: KEPCO is South Korea's state-run electricity utility.

meme.top: A power company disclosed a breach
meme.bottom: the lights stayed on, the data did not
meme.take: KEPCO disclosed a breach affecting 1.5 million people, and is notifying customers.

stories.title: Gothic 3 Classic reaches consoles about 20 years after launch
stories.summary: The 2006 role-playing game Gothic 3 arrived on Xbox in a Classic version on November 24, with PS5 also listed by some outlets.
stories.why: Cult PC role-playing games rarely get console releases two decades later.
stories.happened: Pure Xbox lists Gothic 3 Classic among the week's Xbox releases. GAMINGbible says it is out on PS5 and Xbox and that improvements are also coming to PC.
stories.next: Watch for player reviews of how the console version runs.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The original came out in 2006.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is the first console release for the game.

stories.background: Gothic is a German open-world role-playing series first released in 2001.

meme.top: Gothic 3 reached consoles
meme.bottom: in time for its 20th birthday
meme.take: Gothic 3 came to consoles after 20 years, beating several games still in early access.

stories.title: PS Plus adds four more games, including Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza
stories.summary: PS Plus Extra and Premium added Cricket 26, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii, MotoGP 26 and Trepang2 on November 24.
stories.why: Subscriptions are now a main way people try new games, so each monthly drop matters to players.
stories.happened: GameRant puts the four games' combined retail value at $209.96. They follow earlier November additions including Death Stranding 2 and Atomfall. Sony is expected to reveal December's Essential games on November 25.
stories.next: Watch for Sony's December PS Plus Essential announcement.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The four games are worth about $210 at retail.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: PS Plus competes directly with Xbox Game Pass.

stories.background: PlayStation Plus is Sony's subscription service; its Extra and Premium tiers include a rotating game library.

meme.top: PS Plus added $210 of games
meme.bottom: your backlog filed a complaint
meme.take: PS Plus added $210 of games to a backlog that was already worth more than the console.

stories.title: Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior, with Arkheron on day one
stories.summary: Xbox Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 on November 24, and Arkheron launches in Game Preview on November 27.
stories.why: Game Pass additions decide what millions of subscribers try over the holiday.
stories.happened: PlayStationInfo says Arkheron is a three-player team game where found gear, not a fixed class, sets how you play. Eight games leave the service on November 30.
stories.next: Watch for Microsoft's December Game Pass line-up.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: New games land over Thanksgiving weekend.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Day-one launches on Game Pass are a key Xbox selling point.

stories.background: Xbox Game Pass is Microsoft's subscription that gives access to a rotating library of games.

meme.top: Eight games are leaving Game Pass
meme.bottom: your backlog remains
meme.take: Game Pass adds three games and removes eight, which is still more than most of us finish.
